notes: FleetComm 1.0 — the Night Watch. A ground-up redesign onto the 22nd Expeditionary Fleet design language: ink paper and bone text, gold accents, hairline rules, the fleet clock, and a numbered command rail replacing the old bezel. Everything works exactly as before — same nets, same PTT, same keys, same overlay — it just wears the fleet uniform now. Day mode is now the Daylight watch (warm paper and ink); custom palettes still work. Color language on the board: gold means armed or selected, green means a net is feeding your ears, the one orange-red voice means YOUR carrier is live (ON AIR), and true red means a fault. The in-game overlay keeps its high-legibility typeface. If anything is harder to read than before, that is a bug — report it.
